entities.summary: tvOne, formerly known as Lativi, is an Indonesian free-to-air news television broadcaster based in East Jakarta. It is owned by Visi Media Asia (Viva), which is a part of the Bakrie Group. The network made a test broadcast as Lativi on January 17, 2002, and was launched on July 30 of that year. It was sold by Abdul Latief in 2007, and was rebranded tvOne on February 14, 2008.
